snippet.title: IN & OUT — Official Reveal Trailer | First-Person Puzzle Game
snippet.description:
You wake up inside a place you do not understand.

No instructions. No explanations. Only one rule:

Use everything. In & Out.

IN & OUT is a first-person puzzle game set inside a mysterious facility controlled by an artificial intelligence. Observe your environment, understand its rules and solve each experiment before it is too late.

Every decision matters.
Every detail can be useful.
Failure means starting over.
